                                                                                
 Usage: questor [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                     
                                                                                
 questor: a personal-agent app built on top of QuestorHarness.                  
                                                                                
┌─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --print      -p      <str>  Run a single prompt and exit                     │
│ --model              <str>  Model override for this session                  │
│ --profile            <str>  Provider profile to use                          │
│ --workspace          <str>  Path to the questor workspace (defaults to       │
│                             ~/.questor/agent)                                │
│ --max-turns          <int>  Override max turns                               │
│ --cwd                <str>  Working directory                                │
│                             [default: <REPO>]
│ --resume             <str>  Resume an questor session by id                  │
│ --continue                  Continue the latest questor session              │
│ --help                      Show this message and exit.                      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ init     Initialize the questor workspace.                                   │
│ config   Configure provider profile and gateway channels.                    │
│ doctor   Check questor workspace and provider readiness.                     │
│ memory   Manage questor memory                                               │
│ soul     Inspect or edit soul.md                                             │
│ user     Inspect or edit user.md                                             │
│ gateway  Run the questor gateway                                             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
